rationale: The raw source has separate investment schedule totals of cost 259,337 and fair value 259,073, and a separate unfunded commitments table headed Unfunded Commitment / Fair Value. This grounds the fmt_cost population warning as a real data error caused by commitment-table lookthrough and value remapping, not a false alarm about legitimate source formatting.
